name: Docker Compose Recovery
description: Read the compose file and the failing service logs, repair only that service, and verify health afterward.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read the compose file before changing it.
Inspect logs and recreate only the failing service.
Run compose on a configured server alias when the stack is remote.

validation.rule: The compose file and service logs were inspected before the repair, only the necessary service was recreated, and health was verified afterward.
